name: ASCENT LOTTERY AUTHORITY: District Tier-Up Draw
description: The Ascent Lottery Authority is a HelixCorp-administered lottery system operating across Tiers 1-3, nominally structured as a 'social mobility instrument' in which the grand prize is not a cash sum but a guaranteed Tier 3 residential relocation package, including a twelve-month corporate housing subsidy, a basic BCI upgrade voucher, and a HelixCorp employment pathway registration. Tickets cost Φ2 and are sold through licensed kiosks at synth-protein distribution points, transit nodes, and HelixCorp community centers. The draw is broadcast weekly on Good Morning, Helix with choreographed winner testimonials.
story_hooks: A Tier 1 collective has won the Ascent Draw legitimately — pooling tickets for eleven years — and HelixCorp's legal team is now constructing arguments for why a collective cannot claim a single-individual residential package.

The suppressed 2196 audit has resurfaced with new annotations suggesting the odds manipulation was not an error but a deliberate actuarial decision approved at the executive level — and the original auditor, listed as deceased, may not be.

A HelixCorp kiosk operator has been quietly altering ticket serial numbers for a network of buyers, guaranteeing minor-prize wins in exchange for a cut — the scheme has been running for four years and the operator has no idea their contact is a corporate internal affairs investigator building a much larger case.
